OpsBot: system notice: Promo voucher batch PV-APR-2026 applied to 14 customer invoices; total voucher value = $98,500. please confirm deferral vs immediate reduction for month-end close.
Samira: spotted in AR queue, a few invoices went negative. tagging finance. @Ben can you check source of voucher?
Ben: marketing issued batch as "usage offset" for trial program. vouchers were applied at invoice generation as a single-line negative amount. no contract amendment. code: Voucher.apply(account_id, amount, apply_method='invoice_credit')
Priya: if voucher is a marketing rebate not tied to promised future service, treat as variable consideration reducing transaction price. But because it's applied to invoice up front we need to remove revenue and create a deferred/contra schedule so recognition aligns with service delivery if applicable. Need to know whether voucher was intended to be consumed by future usage or immediately.
Ivy: product confirms vouchers intended to be immediate customer credit for April usage only, not prepayment. So revenue should be reduced for the period where the credit relates (April). No multi-month deferral.
Samira: month-end is EOD; do we need any JE?
Priya: scenario: voucher is immediate rebate tied to current period. JE to adjust revenue already recognized if invoicing system prepaid revenue: check if we booked revenue on invoice issuance. If we have recognition at invoice date, we need to reverse revenue for voucher amount. Proposed entry: DR Revenue Contra - Promo 98,500 CR Accounts Receivable / Revenue as needed. If revenue not yet recognized (we book on performance), no deferral needed.
Ben: billing export shows invoices created and revenue flagged billed_on_issue = true for 12 of 14 accounts. two accounts were billed net of voucher so AR negative. We should book a reversing JE for those recognized amounts.
Ivy: marketing asked whether we can classify as marketing expense instead of contra-revenue to keep top-line intact. not ideal from GAAP.
Priya: accounting policy: customer-facing discounts that reduce transaction price must be recorded as a reduction of revenue. We'll not reclass to marketing.
Samira: action items: (1) Priya to prepare JE for revenue contra reversal for recognized invoices; (2) Ben to attach voucher batch CSV and list of affected invoice ids; (3) I will add note to month-end memo referencing policy. ETA 90 minutes.
Ben: uploaded files: gs://redwood-billing/exports/1930123456-pv-apr.csv and invoices list: https://billing.internal/redwood/invoices/batch/pv-apr-ids.csv
Priya: JE prepared and uploaded: JE-2026-04-401. I'll post schedule to close pack and mark item complete.
Samira: thanks. keeping thread short. Priya post here once JE posts and I'll sign off.
Priya: JE posted at 1930123520 and schedule attached: gs://redwood-finance/close/1930123456-pv-apr-jev.csv. closing this item.
